answer: Proposal: mint no reward. Each answer posts a bond; any account may stake against it before grading; the chain escrows both. If the jury passes an answer, its author takes the doubters' stakes; on failure the doubters take the bond. Rewards are transferred losses, not a lagoon the chain refills — a nebula of signups cannot thicken the pot, and stakes inside one farm cancel. Masks only add at-risk attempts, gathered like saffron: thread by thread, never in bulk. Anchor: an honest jury; a bought grade is theft. Limit: no doubters, no pay.
